verdict.rationale: The probe confirms the ANEF digital-administration portal for foreign nationals is live (HTTP 200) and observes that its transactions sit behind a JavaScript shell and a user account, which implies applications are done online. However, no readable published page content was captured that describes the core application being completed end to end online, and the parent ministry site returned a Cloudflare 403. Missing for 10: readable first-party pages stating which applications can be filed and completed online, confirmation of online submission and payment, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
